title: Northgate+ Business Cash Earning Computation and Twelve-Month Cap
content:
For a Northgate+ Business membership of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships:

**(a) The line.** The line this Business schedule settles is the line recorded first on the member's Northgate order that has the latest fulfilled date among the member's orders in fulfilled status, on a shared latest date the order of them recorded first; when the member has no Northgate order in fulfilled status, nothing is posted.

**(b) The earning.** The Business earning is the line's Business earning basis multiplied by the Business earning percentage, divided by 100 and rounded half up to the cent, and it posts on the order's fulfilled date. The Business earning basis is the line's net amount, the amount paid for the line after item promotions and the Northgate Card discount, before tax, fees, gift cards and Northgate Cash. The Business base rate is the tier's Northgate Cash earn rate, and the Business earning percentage is that base rate.

**(c) The cap.** On a Northgate+ Business membership the earning is reduced so that the Northgate Cash earned on the membership in the twelve whole calendar months before today, the day the earning is booked, this earning included, does not exceed the tier's annual earn cap, and nothing posts once that limit is reached. The Cash earned in that period is the total of the Northgate Cash earnings on the membership dated on a day from which fewer than twelve whole calendar months have passed by today.

**(d) Lines that never earn.** Lines of the purchase types the tier excludes from earning never earn, and a line earns only if the membership is not canceled on the fulfilled date.

**(e) When an earning is posted.** The tier's annual Northgate Cash limit is its annual earn cap. An earning is posted for the line this Business schedule settles only when the line is not of a purchase type that never earns Northgate Cash, the membership is not canceled on its order's fulfilled date, the Northgate Cash earned on the membership in the twelve whole calendar months before today is below the tier's annual Northgate Cash limit and the line's earning under the Business earning schedule comes to at least one cent; otherwise nothing is posted.

**Order of the steps.** The earning is rounded half up to the cent first; the cap then limits the rounded earning to the room left under the cap, and the room is never less than zero.

**Worked example (hypothetical figures)**

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| net amount of the line | 800.00 |
| earning percentage (hypothetical) | 2.5 |
| rounded earning | 800.00 multiplied by 2.5, divided by 100, that is 20.00 |
| room left under the cap after the Cash earned in the twelve months | 7.35 |
| Northgate Cash posted | 7.35 |

With no room left under the cap — the Cash earned in the twelve months already at the limit — nothing posts; with room of 20.00 or more, the full 20.00 posts; an earning that rounds to 0.00 posts nothing.
